acceptance_requirements.client_matrix: Real Epic and Steam clients separately and together, same/UTF-8 names, reconnect and character changes; record evidence per primitive.
acceptance_requirements.reply_scope: Private replies only reach the originating session; expired/nested/worker/old-generation tokens reject; presentation tested separately.
acceptance_requirements.identity_authority: Verify provider and stable canonical subject across restart/maps; opaque observations, display names and process epochs do not authorize accounts.
acceptance_requirements.managed_reload: Only managed callbacks with no surviving plugin workers; pause preserves state, retire drains callbacks/deferred cleanup, old binding/token never revives.
acceptance_requirements.terminal_failure: Deadline or cleanup failure retains mapping; Shutdown/PrepareUnload exception is terminal and visible; no forced close or second Shutdown.
acceptance_requirements.config_recovery: Validate candidate before publication; current reload may leave plugin stopped if next Init/config fails; explicit known-good recovery, no automatic state rollback claim.
acceptance_requirements.persistence: Versioned schema, backup and crash/restart tests; integer amounts bounded, idempotent transactions, no name-based account merging.
acceptance_requirements.world_delivery: Reserve/deliver/reconcile explicit receipt; database and world are not one atomic transaction; uncertain delivery blocks automatic duplicate/refund.
acceptance_requirements.privacy: Identifiers, credentials and raw external payloads omitted from public logs/catalog; operator-owned import copies and explicit provider mapping.
acceptance_requirements.game_thread: No UE access from process timers/workers; copied queues and resident services needed before asynchronous gameplay.

modules.objective: /help, /rules, /motd and /serverinfo from own operator config; /help rules|motd|info uses opt-in arguments.
specific_acceptance: Commands target only origin; no prefix collisions; valid UTF-8 and bounded replies.
Pause suppresses callbacks, resume keeps handles, two reloads show new text without duplicate registration.
Invalid config is rejected and explicit known-good recovery works; no world/character changes.

acceptance_evidence.scope: commands, argument routing and UTF-8 configuration; no in-game UI claim
eleven local requests; start/pause/resume/reload/stop/start; same game process; three actual Essentials loads

modules.objective: Provider-qualified accounts and invalidable sessions for policy, money and later delivery.

persistence_plan.key: cluster + verified_provider + canonical_subject; never inferred from length

specific_acceptance: Epic and Steam subjects remain distinct with equal names; unknown provider gets no authority.
Reconnect/restart/map transfer preserves accepted account mapping but invalidates old session access.
Observed lifecycle duplicates/missing events do not create accounts, grant rights or establish active playtime.

modules.objective: Own groups, permissions, timed grants and audited local administration; protected actions deny unknown authority.

persistence_plan.imports: readonly dry-run; provider/schema mapping and authorized source copies required

specific_acceptance: Only accepted principal can invoke a protected command; renaming does not grant access.
Grant expiry and revocation survive restart; database unavailable or ambiguous account denies.
No auto-admin import, wildcard escalation or implicit trust in observed native ID.

modules.objective: Self-service queries first; authorized roster/kick/ban/whitelist and homes in separate native increments.
specific_acceptance: Self-query isolates caller; administrative query respects permission.
Kick affects exact active target; duplicate names/expired session reject.
Disconnect during action and revoked permission cannot affect replacement session; homes validate map/position.

modules.objective: Own integer virtual balances, journaled grants and account transfers; no item spawning in this slice.

persistence_plan.amounts: bounded exact integers; reject negatives/overflow for balances

specific_acceptance: Concurrent transfers preserve total and cannot overdraw; malformed/overflow input rejects.
Crash/restart/reload or repeated operation ID cannot create another movement.
Steam/Epic accounts remain separate; import totals and conflicts require explicit mapping.

modules.objective: Own catalog, purchases, sales and kit credits; first delivery is one permitted vanilla item.

persistence_plan.uncertainty: needs_reconciliation; no automatic redelivery or refund after uncertain crash

specific_acceptance: Expected item/count goes to purchaser only; price and kit credit consumed consistently.
Full inventory/partial failure/death/transfer produces explicit outcome, not silent success.
Crash between world delivery and journal acknowledgement cannot duplicate items; arbitrary user blueprint paths reject.

modules.objective: Own bounded global relay between two ASE maps; Discord and group formatting optional later.

persistence_plan.network: resident service or plugin hot lifecycle unavailable; no credentials in public configs

specific_acceptance: One global message reaches both clients on other map with correct map label; no echo loop.
Local/tribe chat stays local unless explicit opt-in and ownership verified.
Relay outage/reconnect/replay/backpressure has bounded memory and deduplication; workers never call UE.

modules.objective: One virtual-money award per accepted active-account interval; later scheduled events remain separate.

persistence_plan.mode: unique account + rule_version + period award key and ledger transaction

specific_acceptance: One eligible interval creates one durable award; reload/reconnect/restart cannot replay it.
Missing/duplicate lifecycle observations cannot invent active playtime.
Clock rollback, rule changes, pauses and offline catch-up follow documented policy; no timer UE access.

modules.objective: Observation/recount first, then one verified limit/access/placement decision; advanced decay later.
specific_acceptance: Only appropriate tribe/owner is counted; threshold decision changes original result as specified.
Demolition, restart, load, ownership change and transfer reconcile counts.
Observer-only callback never claims blocking; policy reload reconciles old state before admission.

implemented_subset.scope: copied scoped observations only; policies/mutations pending

modules.objective: Read/ownership first, then one carry/tame/limit rule; colors, spawning and breeding separate.
specific_acceptance: Rule distinguishes correct rider, owner, tribe and target dino.
Death, untame, tame, cryo/transfer, stasis and restart do not drift counts or leave stale refs.
Unsupported native hook fails closed for activation; decorative changes/spawn are not implied by observer success.

implemented_subset.scope: copied scoped observations only; policies/mutations pending

modules.objective: Read membership and tribe MOTD first; consistent cross-map roles/tribes and merges later.
specific_acceptance: Only current authorized role changes MOTD; unrelated player cannot read protected data.
Leave/kick/promote/transfer/restart invalidates stale membership immediately.
Reused tribe IDs and divergent maps cannot merge ownership without reviewed reconciliation.
